definitions.text: Arrays keep a list of values in order. Use an index to pick an item, starting at zero for the first one.
Objects keep related information together as named properties. A learner object might hold a name, a score, and a method for updating that score.
An if statement checks a condition and runs code when it passes. Add else to say what should happen when it doesn't.
The Document Object Model (DOM) represents a web page as a tree. JavaScript uses it to find elements, change their content, or add new ones.
Events tell your code something happened, like a click or a keypress. Add a listener to run a function whenever that event occurs.
